purpose: The best scored parent uses pointwise BCE and has a material GAUC-to-top-five gap, while the only attempted objective change (user-normalized BCE) regressed. Literature is needed to choose one bounded ranking-loss ablation and avoid an under-specified or computationally infeasible objective experiment.
query: Retrieve repository literature on within-user ranking-aligned objectives suitable for binary long-view impression ranking, prioritizing RankNet pairwise loss and mixed group ListNet/Top-1 loss. Include implementation requirements for constructing causal within-user training groups, negative sampling or weighting, computational complexity, and expected GAUC versus nDCG@5 tradeoffs relative to pointwise BCE.

purpose: Existing screened historical aggregates regressed, but this does not resolve whether a causally truncated sequence representation can address poor top-five ordering. Literature is needed to determine whether such a representation is valid and sufficiently distinct from rejected aggregate histories before proposing a scarce experiment.
query: Retrieve repository literature on leakage-safe causal behavior-history and candidate-conditioned history-attention methods for temporal recommendation. Focus on exact event-time truncation, handling unavailable/current-impression outcomes, compact bounded histories, candidate-aware user-item interaction, and efficiency under a 900-second experiment limit.
